description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Mona Lisa.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mona Lisa, Science Geek
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
